safe_proposal: Only after peer/Root grant, background hydrate exact missing regular-file blobs from existing local Git into this OWN existing tree; verify blob size/SHA/mode, create no dummy files, refuse any occupied path, never overwrite modified inputs; recheck actual free before each batch and stop below3GiB. No network/LFS/filter/newcheckout.
filesystem_allocation_note: Apparent bytes understate allocation for tiny files; runtime floor must include conservative overhead and per-batch free-space checks.
